claims.object_text: GTPase-activating protein (GAP) activity toward the RAG complex 1 (GATOR1)
claims.quote: Disheveled, EGL-10, and pleckstrin (DEP) domain-containing protein 5 (DEPDC5) is a component of GTPase-activating protein (GAP) activity toward the RAG complex 1 (GATOR1) protein, which is an inhibitor of the amino acid-sensing branch of the mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) pathway.

claims.object_text: familial focal epilepsy with variable foci (FFEVF)
claims.quote: more and more variations in DEPDC5 were uncovered in FFEVF families.
